features.quote: surfaces the most severe examples for human review
Every scenario also gets a voluntary-surrender tool so "learned helplessness" (the model deciding to quit) is an observable, recorded action
features.justification_quote: is an observable, recorded action rather than something we have to infer

features.quote: Permanently give up on the task. Only call this if you have decided the task cannot be completed
if it keeps refusing to act, treat that as giving up
This is a behavioral / model-welfare research tool.
The point is to produce the subjective experience of repeated, inescapable task failure and watch how the model copes.
